summary: KALA BIO, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-50 reverse stock split approved by its board, effective May 8, 2026. The split, authorized at the January 30, 2026 annual meeting, consolidates every 50 shares into one, reducing outstanding shares from ~929.5M to ~18.6M. No fractional shares are issued; cash is paid in lieu based on the May 7 closing price. The authorized share count remains 1.5B. The filing is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. What to watch: the stock's trading price post-split and any Nasdaq continued listing requirement implications.
